cases.name: attributed-box-cylinder-arc-round-seam-mid-r2
cases.note: A box 40 long, 10 wide and 15 high joined with SmApiCreateCylinder r 10, h 35 at (0, 0, -5) (below the box's base, so no face is coplanar); the box along +X: the cylinder's seam (+X) crosses the arc's middle, so the arc is two edges. The concave arc where the box's top (z 15) meets the cylinder is rounded r 2 (SmApiFilletEdgesPerEdge, circular).

The concave arc where the box's top (z 15) meets the cylinder is rounded r 2 (SmApiFilletEdgesPerEdge, circular).
